name: OPGI Chlef data center and structure interconnection project
developer: OPGI de la wilaya de Chlef
notes: Tender-aggregator archive (C) records a national consultation by OPGI Chlef for study/supervision of a project to create a data center and interconnect structures; no capacity or build status disclosed, remains C-grade lead.

name: University of Laghouat datacenter / HPC computer room
developer: University of Laghouat (Amar Telidji) / ICE Informatique et Communication d Entreprises
notes: ICE company presentation (C) lists University of Laghouat among references for PROJET D AMENAGEMENT SALLE INFORMATIQUE (DATACENTER) with HPC/IBM Linux cluster; official university domain identified but no facility page opened; institutional server-room evidence only.

name: University Batna-2 data center and high-performance computing unit
notes: Official university page (A) states the high-performance computing unit entered full operation in 2022, distinguishing Batna-2; APS-based local report (B) says a data center was built in parallel with the university since 2016 to host servers/storage/security equipment. Institutional compute facility.

name: Djezzy Cloud Data Center, Amizour
notes: datacenters.com directory (C) lists Djezzy Cloud DC at Afra, Amizour, Bejaia; Djezzy sovereign-cloud service is A-grade service evidence but the Amizour physical facility remains unverified by operator page or ARPCE/permit in this run; Villpress (C/B) describes Djezzy cloud platform.

name: Second National Digital Services Data Center, Blida
developer: High Commission for Digitalization / Huawei consortium
notes: HCN-Huawei accord repost (A/B) names Blida as the second national data center; BOMOP/ANEP tender (A) covers owner-assistance for IT and Data Center Facilities works of the national digital services DC; Algerie Eco (B) reports Conseil des ministres approved direct-negotiation contract with Huawei. Works phase - not operational.

name: Algeria Telecom Lakhdaria data center project
notes: DCD (B) notes Algeria Telecom announced plans (2017) for a new data center near its Lakhdaria satellite hub, Bouira; Ecofin (B) reported a planned international-class facility in the Lakhdaria area; no fresh official commissioning found - kept as planned historical project.

name: Algerie Poste postal complex data center (Tiaret)
notes: MPT official visit page (A, per DZ methodology verified official list) states the Tiaret postal complex includes a data center; institutional postal IT facility rather than commercial colocation; capacity not disclosed.

name: UMMTO Data Center HPC/AI & Cloud Prive
notes: UMMTO official tender (A) for acquisition/installation of a Data Center HPC/AI and private-cloud solution; May 2025 official university report (A) says the minister launched works and visited the future data-center premises. Institutional HPC facility under construction.

name: Mohammadia Data Center / Data Center National 1
developer: High Commission for Digitalization; Huawei Consortium
notes: National Data Center 1 at Mohammadia, Algiers (National Digital Services Center): APS (A) reports Uptime Institute Tier III Design certification; Agence Ecofin (B) confirms the certification and president-ordered interconnection of public services; operational per APS/state coverage.

name: eBS / WebServices Data Center (Sidi Abdellah Cyber Parc)
notes: WebServices operator page (A) states the DC was realized at the multi-tenant Sidi Abdellah Cyber Parc, 85 sqm, Tier III, split into 35 sqm production + 50 sqm extension rooms; Data Center Map (C) lists the address; capacity not confirmed by official source (2 MW directory figure unverified).

name: AYRADE cloud/data center services (DC1 TASSILI)
notes: AYRADE operator page (A) for data-center/cloud services; ARPCE cloud-authorisation page (A) lists AYRADE SPA with registered address at Mohammadia Mall, Alger; Data Center Map (C) places AYRADE DC1 (TASSILI) at Cyber Parc Sidi Abdellah Rahmania. Service evidence A, physical facility address C - overall B.

name: ICOSNET Algiers DATA CENTER (Cheraga)
notes: ICOSNET official page (A) states the operator runs two secure local data centers in Algeria; Data Center Map (C) places the Algiers DC at Centre commercial El-Qods, 6th level central tower, Cheraga; facility-level specifics not published on official page - overall B.

name: APN Parliament Data Center
notes: Directory-only lead (C): APN Parliament Data Center in Algiers, reported inaugurated 2024-10-31 for processing/storage/archiving/security; no official APN/government page opened this run.

name: Ministry of Housing Secondary Data Center at OPGI Djelfa
developer: Ministry of Housing, Urbanism and the City (MHUv) / OPGI Djelfa
notes: Official MHUv tender page (A) covers firewalls and Veeam licenses at the secondary data center at OPGI Djelfa; DZtenders (C) corroborates the firewall/Veeam procurement. Institutional secondary DC, in service per ongoing maintenance tenders.

name: KOTAMA AGRI-FOOD datacenter network security project
notes: Tender aggregator (C) records KOTAMA AGRI-FOOD procurements for secured SDN campus/datacenter network infrastructure and redundant NGFW for edge/datacenter (region Jijel, site RN 43 El Achouat, Taher); internal enterprise datacenter activity, not colocation.
